# Nook

> Nook is a virtual co-working app that lets remote workers, students, and freelancers focus alongside real people in shared rooms — no camera, no scheduling, no pressure. Free on web and Android.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.moonga.studio/nook/): overview of rooms and features
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.moonga.studio/nook/privacy.html): what data is collected and how it is used
- [Terms of Use](https://www.moonga.studio/nook/terms.html): terms governing use of the app
- [Delete Account](https://www.moonga.studio/nook/delete-account.html): how to delete your account and data
- [Android app](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=studio.moonga.flow): install on Android

## About
- Built by Moonga Studio — hello@moonga.studio
- Free to use; no account required to join open rooms
- Private rooms require a free account
- Data processed in EU (Supabase Frankfurt); analytics via PostHog EU
